What is a stock?: a share in the ownership of a company
What are bonds?: fixed income instruments that represent loans made by an investor to a borrower
What is inflation?: the rate at which the general level of prices for goods and services is rising
What does a mutual fund do?: purchase a diversified portfolio of stocks, bonds, or other securities
What is the stock market?: a marketplace where investors can buy and sell shares of publicly traded companies
What is a dividend?: a cash payment a company makes to its shareholders out of its profits
What does the Sharpe ratio measure?: the return earned above the risk-free rate
What is the risk-free rate?: the return on an investment with no default risk
What is the efficient frontier?: the set of portfolios that offer the highest expected return
What does covariance measure?: how the returns of two assets move together
What is rebalancing?: buying and selling assets to bring a portfolio back to its target weights
How is market capitalization calculated?: equal to share price multiplied by shares outstanding
What does beta measure?: how much a stock tends to move when the overall market moves by one percent
